text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove was crowned the URA Umamusume 
of the Year. Her dignified presence 
carried the true aura befitting the 
representative of a generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Air Groove, Mejiro Dober 
becomes convinced that if she chases after 
her and becomes like her, she can bring 
about a "new glory for the Mejiros."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I felt a subtle sense of unease watching 
Mejiro Dober... Though I couldn't quite 
figure out what it was.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Mejiro Bright was undergoing 
grueling special training with her sights 
set on the Tenno Sho (Spring). Concerned 
by this, Mejiro Ryan called out to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, upon learning the depth of Mejiro 
Bright's devotion to the Mejiro family and 
its future, Mejiro Ryan cheered her on.
